content.short: Listed in Canada and on Nasdaq, SOL Strategies runs Solana validators and offers the STKESOL liquid staking token.
content.description: SOL Strategies was called Cypherpunk Holdings until it rebranded in 2024 to focus on Solana. It grew its validator business by acquiring Cogent Crypto, Orangefin and Laine, and it stakes for funds and individual delegators. Retail holders can use STKESOL, its liquid staking token. The company also owns privacy tools including Houdini Swap and Darklake. It trades as HODL in Canada and STKE on Nasdaq. The company wants to be the infrastructure institutions rely on for Solana, and its privacy products now include Zyga as well as Houdini Swap.
